name: syngas_pilot_record
purpose: Data contract for the Ni/MgAl2O4 pilot campaign described in docs/27_v5_pilot_test_program.md. model/data_ingest.py validates a CSV or JSON file against this contract and then reruns the loop-5 comparisons automatically. The contract exists so that the campaign CANNOT produce data the model cannot use: every field below is a field the model consumes.
source_of_requirements: results_v2/verification_v2.json -> loops.5_validation_falsification.unchecked_items (design-point campaign, measured dP, 200-1000 h sintering series, catalyst datasheet)
units_policy: Units are FIXED and stated in the column name. Do not report a value in another unit; add a derived column instead. Temperatures in K (not C), pressures in bar absolute (not gauge), flows at 0 C / 101325 Pa (normal, dry) unless the column says 'actual'.
record_id_policy: run_id must be unique per record and stable; if you rerun a point, use run_id-2 etc. and put the reason in 'notes'.

date.desc: measurement date (start of the time-on-stream window for that point)

catalyst_id.desc: must match a catalyst datasheet record: manufacturer, trade name, batch

Ni_wt_pct.desc: reduced-metal basis; state which (Ni or NiO) in notes

support.desc: e.g. MgAl2O4, phase, vendor trade name

bed_voidage.desc: measured or packed-bed estimate; 'measured' or 'estimated' goes in regime.voidage_source

diluent_inert_mol_frac.desc: alpha-Al2O3 or SiC dilution of the bed, if any

rho_loaded_kg_m3.desc: loose/loaded density of the bed as charged

T_K.desc: BED temperature at the catalyst zone, measured (not furnace setpoint); state sensor type in regime.*

p_bar.desc: upstream of the bed; the loop-5 gap is 20-31 bar, so those points are the priority

GHSV_h1_normal.desc: normal-m3 gas per m3 of packed bed per hour; state catalyst-volume vs bed-volume in regime.ghsv_volume_basis

contact_time_regime.desc: author's judgement; the model re-checks it with Weisz-Prater / Mears estimates

conversion_basis.desc: whether y_CH4_out was computed on a dry or wet basis - the model refuses ambiguous records

X_CH4_u.desc: combined uncertainty incl. balance closure; if you only have relative precision, convert it

balance_closure_pct.desc: C and O elemental balance closure of the analysis; the model flags |closure| > 5 %

dP_bed_bar.desc: measured across the packed bed only (state the tap locations in notes); THIS IS A LOOP-5 BLOCKER

time_on_stream_h.desc: cumulative hours since reduction at THIS data point; a sintering series must have >= 4 values spanning 0-1000 h

Ni_size_nm.desc: mean metallic Ni particle size (TEM preferred, XRD-Scherrer accepted - state which in regime.size_method)

coke_wt_pct.desc: TPO or LECO after the run

X_CH4_at_end_of_series.desc: activity at the end of a stability block, same conditions as the t=0 point

regime_block.desc: optional but strongly wanted: it is what lets the model decide whether a point is comparable to an equilibrium calculation at all

analysis.desc: GC type, detectors, calibration standard, whether N2 or Ar was used as internal standard

minimum_useable_matrix.desc: the smallest campaign that changes loop-5 status; anything less leaves the same subchecks failed

sintering_series.fixed: T=1123.15 K, S_C=2.5, p=25 bar, same GHSV

minimum_useable_matrix.acceptance_vs_model: a model/pilot agreement of |mean bias| <= 0.05 in X_CH4 with the model's own uncertainty band, or an explained regime difference, is what closes the design-point subcheck
